title: Markets plunge as crude tops $108, Rupee hits 94.8; FIIs dump ₹1.14 lakh crore in March - The HinduBusinessLine
summary: Indian markets faced a significant downturn due to escalating West Asia tensions, surging crude oil prices, a weak rupee, and substantial foreign fund outflows. Brent and WTI crude oil prices saw notable increases, exacerbating the situation.
sentiment_reason: The market sentiment is strongly negative due to the combination of geopolitical tensions, high crude oil prices, currency volatility, and aggressive foreign fund outflows, all of which contribute to a risk-off mood and potential inflationary pressures on the Indian economy.
